The '''King's Hall''' was a subterranean vault underneath the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gorma-Koss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The king of the Gormak, [[Jokull]], stored treasures and trophies from his past conquests in the complex, including maps of the [[Nightmare Lands]].
